name: OceanView
description: Browse Protobuf and debug gRPC / HTTP / SSE / WebSocket APIs inside DBX. Requires Node.js >= 18 on PATH.
releaseNotes: v0.1.3: ExcelView find now scrolls the hit cell into view; hold right mouse button + wheel to scroll horizontally. DocsView gains the same find bar. Still requires Node.js >= 18 on PATH.
